## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta9

### Current-cycle trail view
- Align the default live map with Navimower 0.4.3-beta41 current-cycle trail semantics.
- When the integration marks `daily_trails.scope` as `current_cycle`, rename the default history selector from `Today` to `Current cycle`.
- Keep historical date views session-based and unchanged, so yesterday/older views remain tied to retained session history rather than the live current-cycle overlay.
- Keep compatibility with older integrations: without the `current_cycle` scope marker, the selector continues to show `Today`.
